summary: A comment is a note for people reading your code. JavaScript skips it when the program runs.
notes: // starts a comment that runs to the end of the line.
/* and */ wrap a block comment that can cover several lines.
/** */ is a JSDoc comment. Put it right above a function or at the top of a file to describe it.
pitfall: Using # for a comment, as in Python, causes SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token. JavaScript comments use //.
contrast: JavaScript comments look like Java's: //, /* */, and /** */ (called JSDoc). Python uses # instead, and JavaScript has no docstring that the program can read like Python's __doc__.
